inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The operation is not operating in compliance with the agreed upon action actions for the plan of action period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: Four trampolines were moved to be side by side, not following the use zone requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There are lose fabrics around the trampolines which can result in children tripping and injuring themselves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: The director and infant caregiver did not have current infant trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the children they were responsible for when they left a child in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left alone in the restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated during an investigation. A caregiver did not follow policies and procedures during transition to keep track of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was evaluated during an investigation. A child was left outside unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation did not report to CCR within two days of a child requiring medical treatment due to an injury caused at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: A child was in time out for an excessive amount of time, longer than one minute per age of the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not notify CCR after finding out a child was placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A child was grabbed by a caregiver by the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: None of the caregiver trainings reviewed had the annual health and safety trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection has not been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 1 of the 10 children files reviewed did not have medical emergency authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined that the operation failed to notify licensing of a situation that may have placed children at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): An employee did not have a complete notarized affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash a child's hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation: It was found that training document dates did not align with dates of training completion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities - Not interfere with an inspection or investigation (26 TAC §745.8411(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments: Two employees were placed together without the proper skills and abilities to care for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §746.1003(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The caregivers did not complete checks appropriately resulting in a child being left unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left in the bathroom for an extended period of time without a caregiver present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Five children that are not yet on table foods did not have updated written feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: Two infant files did not have the operational policies on infant safe sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Nine staff members did not have their high school diplomas in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A child's file was missing the child's current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One child's file was missing the authorized release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit: A staff member's file was missing a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit (26 TAC §HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Nine children's files were missing addresses for their emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement: A child's file was missing the enrollment form
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Two children's files were missing the healthcare statement
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report incidents where children were at risk to licensing in a timely manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Three caregivers were in the classrooms with children without active background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A caregiver was physically aggressive with a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last fire drill was conducted in June 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver yelled at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: A child was not tended to promptly following an accident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))
